reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

rules.explicit_membership: All109 authored D/R route records, with prior assigned directions retaining their original effective judgment. Each source has a literal native/current guard and a distinct predicate/activity/comparator/residual. No correspondence is inferred from title, lineage difference or the earlier reverse label.
rules.remaining_premises: The formal statement, method semantics, proof/check result and any real observation, implementation mapping, physical/sample model or authority are not supplied unless the source itself establishes that fact at its qualified scope.
rules.nontrigger: An unrelated formal task, arbitrary textual encoding or an application outside the native guard. A pure theorem can remain valid without this particular application; the rule neither mandates its use nor rejects alternatives.
rules.source_ceiling: Inherited qualified source warrants and own explicit analytical member routes, with constructed controls at their stated scope. No new field realization, complete empirical validation, independent replication or executed method for every member is claimed.
rules.partial_input: The native input may be a requirement, used assumption, evidence-scope qualifier or cost/choice criterion. It need not establish the whole formal receiving property. A known partial input is credited even when other application premises remain unresolved.
rules.subsumption: Several inputs restate already explicit formal/engineering guards. Materiality does not imply independence, indispensability or a new property identity.
rules.cost_alternative: Retain the exact member comparator and the burden of specification, checking, observations and upkeep. A direct check or no additional activity can be sufficient.
rules.authority_effect_boundary: Neither a scientific criterion nor a proof premise confers operating authority or performs the external action.
rules.reverse: The earlier formal-to-engineering direction addresses scope of a formal result; this direction supplies content for the formal receiving decision. Their arguments and remaining premises differ; no equivalence is asserted.
rules.reentry: Changed native/current meaning, required function, domain, method semantics, application evidence, environment, costs or consumer boundary reopens the affected input.
rules.shared_question: What exact function/event/state or calculation is this particular formal statement supposed to express?
rules.changed_receiving_inference: The D/R source supplies the named required predicate and its actual operation, mission, observation or numerical domain. This changes the statement that F001 must identify; it can reveal that a precise proxy omits the intended distinction. It does not prove the resulting formula.
rules.guard: The formal task is the specific activity in the source member route. Interpret its predicate as a claim about the native bearer, not a string containing the property text. Preserve source guard, current qualification and allowed narrower objectives.
rules.contrary_and_positive_control: NX02 has the same encoded paragraph in worlds with opposite functional truth. That arbitrary encoding supplies no such predicate correspondence. By contrast, D19 supplies the erasure/interleaving objective and R026 supplies the actual event/exposure question. A pure formal lemma need not acquire an external purpose.
